label: TP
reason: User-supplied cookie value flows directly into bar via decodeBase64->getBytes->new String, then gets passed to encodeForHTML which outputs unescaped HTML to the response stream. The double-base64 roundtrip does not sanitize against XSS payloads, and the sink concatenates the encoded string directly into the HTTP response body.

evidence.note: cookie value decoded and re-encoded passes through to encodeForHTML sink
